notes.uri: null blocks sending: put the address of the served metadata file (name Pooter, symbol POOTER, an image) here before step 2
notes.symbol: also the ticker scripts/init-hunch.mjs stores in Hunch's state (initialize, for good): 1 to 10 characters, A-Z and 0-9 only. The diary names the coin by it
notes.startUsd: the user's choice, copied from $MONKEY ($7,000); confirm before step 1
notes.graduationUsd: the user's choice, copied from $MONKEY ($40,000); confirm before step 1
notes.devBuySol: 0 = no developer buy (not decided by the user). Above 0, the buy rides inside step 2 (STEP=token) as the pool's first swap, after the creator transfer to the budget PDA, and the config turns on DBC's first-swap-with-min-fee so that this one buy pays 3.75% instead of the 50% opening fee (no outside trade can get it). There is no separate buy step.
notes.fixed: curveFeeBps, poolFeeBps, openingFeeBps, openingFeeSeconds, creatorSharePct, the LP split, decimals and metadataCanChange are compiled into the Hunch program (adopt_curve refuses any other config): the tool refuses values that differ
